page_title: GEN 1-2 INT | Genoa v Inter 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' Referee Daniele Doveri halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Daniele De Rossi, then shows him a yellow.
90+6' Although Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is just on the bench, Daniele Doveri has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+1' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+1' The goalkeeper made a fine save to prevent Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) from converting his header after a dangerous cross. The ball went into the middle of the goal, where the goalkeeper was standing.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Piotr Zielinski goes off the pitch and Stefan de Vrij (Inter) comes on.
89' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Mikael Egill Ellertsson and he is replaced by Valentin Carboni (Genoa).
89' Today's match ends for Sebastian Otoa who will be replaced by Maxwel Cornet (Genoa).
88' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.
88' Marcus Thuram (Inter) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
87' The referee points to the corner flag and Inter will take a corner.
84' That will be all from Lautaro Martinez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Andy Diouf (Inter).
82' The ball is out of play and Genoa manage to earn a corner.
81' Albert Gronbaek (Genoa) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort goes towards the middle of the goal. Not a big deal for the goalkeeper.
78' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) replacing Vitinha.
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Morten Frendrup as he is replaced by Albert Gronbaek (Genoa).
78' Daniele Doveri rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Yann Bisseck (Inter).
77' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
74' Cristian Chivu has decided to make a change. Marcus Thuram (Inter) replaces Francesco Pio Esposito.
74' Substitution. Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) replaces Petar Sucic.
73' Nicolo Barella (Inter) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
68' 1 - 2 Vitinha (Genoa) gets one-on-one with the goalkeeper and takes an early shot which finds the back of the net.
68' Yann Bisseck (Inter) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
68' Nicolo Barella (Inter) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
66' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
63' Nicolo Barella (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
60' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
58' Substitution. Lorenzo Colombo makes his way off the pitch and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes on as his replacement.
57' Inter are awarded a free kick from long range.
56' Petar Sucic (Inter) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
54' Manuel Akanji (Inter) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
52' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Johan Vasquez (Genoa) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
47' Nicolo Barella (Inter) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now. Yann Bisseck (Inter) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.

45+1' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch. The game is interrupted now, Yann Bisseck (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) plays a long ball to Vitinha, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.

38' 0 - 2 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
36' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:4.
33' A free kick from far out for Inter. We are about to see the outcome very soon.
32' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) hammers the ball to the right side of the goal, but it's not so easy to put it behind Nicola Leali, who denies him with a terrific save.
32' Yann Bisseck (Inter) and Nicolo Barella are exchanging a few passes as if neither of them want to be the one to start a new attack.
28' Carlos Augusto (Inter) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Carlos Augusto (Inter) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
22' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
21' Nicolo Barella (Inter) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
20' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Inter.
20' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 36:64.
17' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Inter out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
15' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
12' Nicolo Barella (Inter) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. It's a free kick to Genoa, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
10' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) smashes the ball upfield and Carlos Augusto controls it with a great first touch.
6' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Yann Bisseck (Inter) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Lautaro Martinez provided an assist for the goal.
5' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Vitinha.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Genoa will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
